class.name: OcgGraphic3dAspectline3d
class.brief_description: Creates and updates a group of attributes for 3d line primitives. This group contains the color, the type of line, and its thickness.

method.name: from_2
method.description: Creates a context table for line primitives defined with the specified values. Warning: theWidth is the "line width scale factor". The nominal line width is 1 pixel. The width of the line is determined by applying the line width scale factor to this nominal line width. The supported line widths vary by 1-pixel units.

method.name: SetWidth_1
method.description: Modifies the line thickness. Warning: Raises Standard_OutOfRange if the width is a negative value.
